SciCode

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Distinct primary paper work or creator-named benchmark family. Actual complete primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-document scopes have exact author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI reviews on the approved bounded assertions. Original first-submitted drafts and their genuine revise history are preserved. Raw dataset payloads were not recounted, experiments were not rerun, upstream rights were not independently cleared and no supplier role is inferred. This admission is not a frozen-core denominator decision.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SciCode · documents: In the v1 paper’s standard setup, models receive no supplied scientific background and carry forward generated solutions; a main problem counts as solved only when all subproblems and the integrated main solution are correct.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SciCode · documents: The v1 paper reports 80 main problems and 338 subproblems across 16 subfields; development has 15 main problems and 50 subproblems, while test has 65 main problems and 288 subproblems.
